dct_description_sm: The file contains the following variables and measurement units: sample.name, latitude = latitude (decimal degrees), longitude = longitude (decimal degrees), altitude = altitude (m), wind = wind (m/s) ,chla_concentration = chlorophyl (ug/L), tp_concentration = total phosphorous (ug/L), tn_concentration = total nitrogen (mg/L), doc = dissolved organic carbon (mg/L), dic = dissolved inorganic carbon (mg/L), area = lake area (Km2), WRT= water retention time (day), Hindex = human impact index, perccipitation_30days = 30 days period precipitation (m), solar_30days = 30 days period solar radiation (J m-2 day-1), humidity = humidity (%), pressure = pressure (hPa), temperature = Temperature (C), watershed.km2 = watershed area (km2), w.temperature = water temperature (C), light = light in the water column (umol photo m-2 s-1), max_depth = Maximum depth (m), water = fraction of water (%), fraction_forest = Fraction of forest (%), fraction_urban = Fraction of urban (%), fraction_agriculture = Fraction of agriculture (%), fraction_pasture = Fraction of pasture (%), fraction_natlandscapes = Fraction of natural landscapes, D.excess = deuterium excess (‰), pH = potential of hydrogen, C1 = component 1 identified by PARAFAC, C1_P = fluorescence intensity of component 1 as a percentage, C2_P = fluorescence intensity of component 2 as a percentage, C3_P = fluorescence intensity of component 3 as a percentage, C4_P = fluorescence intensity of component 4 as a percentage, C5_ = fluorescence intensity of component 5 as a percentage,  aliphatic, Aromatic, low.O.unsaturated = Low oxygen unsaturated, high.O.unsaturated = High oxygen unsaturated, polyphenols, condensed aromatics, gppv = volumetric GPP (mg O2 m-3 d-1), rv = volumetric R (mg O2 m-3 d-1), nepv = volumetric NEP (mg O2 m-3 d-1),

Data was sampled during summer months of 2017, 2018 and 2019 as part of LakePulse Network. Environmental data and samples for DOM quantification and spectrofluorometric and molecular characterization as well as estimated volumetric rates of gross primary production (GPP), ecosystem respiration (R), and the resulting net ecosystem production (NEP) were sampled across Canadian lakes and each lake visited and sampled once. The metabolism data have been presented in the study Shahabinia and others (2025), whereas the DOM data have not been published yet, but the sampling methodology is common.
dct_title_s: LakePulse Network: FT-ICR-MS, PARAFAC, metabolism and related environmental data (Canada, 2017-2019)
